title: Cycle-25 A.4 witness-mechanism viability discriminator (cycle 24 follow-up) + cycle-29 option (c) self-allocated witness + cycle-31 option (d) on-screen visual breadcrumb
purpose: Minimal real-Xbox-only diagnostic XBE that fires the cycle-23 A.4 kseg0-scan witness twice (stages MAIN_ENTERED=1 + POST_MARKER0=3) with 500 ms sleep gaps, then HalReturnToFirmware(HalRebootRoutine)s. Cycle 29 ADDED an option (c) self-witness AFTER the existing cycle-23 fires (Codex round-1 high finding #1 adopted — ordering keeps the cycle-23 path bit-identical to cycle 25 up to and including the second cycle-23 fire): after the unchanged cycle-23 fires + 500 ms inter-fire sleep, main() also calls xbed_self_witness_fire(MAIN_ENTERED) + xbed_self_witness_fire(POST_MARKER0), which allocates the XBE's OWN persistent contiguous page via MmAllocateContiguousMemoryEx + MmPersistContiguousMemory and stamps a unique 'WTNS' magic + reserved0=(0xA4<<24)|stage + reserved1=counter at known offsets in that page. The relaunched cycle-29 oracle-agent (commit on `apple-silicon-performance`) exposes a new read-only witness.scan-self verb that enumerates 'WTNS' pages in kseg0 [0x80010000, 0x84000000]. Cycle 31 ADDED an option (d) on-screen visual breadcrumb: BEFORE the cycle-25 host-log line, main() now calls XVideoSetMode(640, 480, 32, REFRESH_DEFAULT) + paints a 96-row RED stripe (stripe 0) into the resulting linear framebuffer; AFTER each subsequent checkpoint (xbed_a4_witness_fire(MAIN_ENTERED) return, xbed_a4_witness_fire(POST_MARKER0) return, xbed_self_witness_fire(MAIN_ENTERED) return, xbed_self_witness_fire(POST_MARKER0) return), main() paints the next 96-row stripe (ORANGE / YELLOW / GREEN / BLUE; ARGB8888 0xFFFF7F00 / 0xFFFFFF00 / 0xFF00FF00 / 0xFF0000FF). The pre-reboot Sleep is extended from cycle 25's 500 ms to 2000 ms so a composite-capture stream at ~30 fps captures ≥60 frames of the final painted state. NO pbkit, NO NV2A class-object setup, NO xbed_init, NO file I/O. XVideoSetMode is the only kernel display call (calls AvGetSavedDataAddress + MmAllocateContiguousMemoryEx (PAGE_WRITECOMBINE) + AvSetDisplayMode + XVideoSetGammaRamp — the same kernel paths lib/xbed_runtime.c:43-60 uses for every diag XBE that draws anything). The intermediate marker helper (image-blit's `image_blit_marker(0, ...)` fopen) is REPLACED with a passive `Sleep(500)` — a successful cycle-26 outcome therefore proves the witness mechanism is real-Xbox-safe in this minimal context but does NOT independently exclude the marker helper as a contributor to image-blit's hang. Built via lib/lib.mk so it links xbed_a4_witness.c exactly the way image-blit does. Cycle 26 (Hermes-scheduled) ran the cycle-25 build on real Xbox and observed outcome D (no XCTR stamp landed); cycle 28 (cycle-27 preserve-branch oracle-agent) reproduced D-cycle-27 and INVALIDATED the 'stamp landed and got wiped' hypothesis. Cycle 30 ran the cycle-29 build and observed outcome E2 (witness.scan D-cycle-27 + witness.scan-self count=0) — (γ) 'main() never reaches the fire calls' is LEADING; cycle-22 pre-main-crash hypothesis RE-STRENGTHENED. Cycle 32 (Hermes's call) will deploy the cycle-31 build + arm the composite-capture leg: the deepest visible stripe in captured frames near reboot time discriminates γ at the 'did main() execute at all?' granularity — stripe 0 visible INVALIDATES (γ); stripe 0 absent strengthens cycle-22 toward FULLY corroborated. See README.md for the full cycle-32 discriminator semantics table + the 5-stripe map + the deployment runbook.

witness_readback.notes: Cycle 26: after chainload reboots Xbox to dashboard FTP and the oracle agent is re-launched, run `oracle-client.py raw witness.scan`. With cycle-27 option (a) active (oracle-agent commit on `apple-silicon-performance`), `s_allocate_fresh` preserves an A.4-stamped header across agent re-launch when the kernel pool returns the same persistent phys (the cycle-26-observed behavior on this Xbox), so a successful witness fire can surface EITHER (i) as an orphan with reserved[0] == 0xA4xxxxxx (legacy orphan shape) OR (ii) as the LIVE buffer itself carrying reserved[0] == 0xA4xxxxxx (cycle-27 preserve-branch shape). Expected payloads: 0xA4000003 (both fires landed; witness mechanism real-Xbox-safe IN THIS MINIMAL XBE; marker helper exclusion requires a follow-on cycle) | 0xA4000001 (first fire only; second fire hung box but soft-reset eventually triggered) | (no readback because Xbox is hung indefinitely) | live=1 reserved0=0 (witness writes never landed; mechanism real-Xbox-incompatible OR fires returned phys=0). Cycle 29 adds the cycle-29 option (c) readback via the new `witness.scan-self` verb (sister verb to `witness.scan`): enumerates kseg0 pages with the diag-XBE's OWN 'WTNS' magic + version 1 + plausibility-filter on reserved[0,1]. After a cycle-30 chainload + relaunched cycle-27/29 agent, both verbs should be queried — witness.scan reports the cycle-23 XCTR-scan outcome (same shapes as cycle 28) AND witness.scan-self reports the cycle-29 self-allocated-page outcome. The two readbacks together discriminate (α) vs (γ); see expected_results.real-xbox/physical/cycle-30 for the full shape table.

real-xbox/physical/cycle-26.notes: Cycle 26 expected outcome A (witness mechanism real-Xbox-safe IN THIS MINIMAL XBE): Xbox reboots in ~5..15 s; agent witness.scan after re-launch shows either (i) LEGACY ORPHAN SHAPE: a NEW orphan (separate phys from the live buffer) with reserved[0] == 0xA4000003 and reserved[1] == 2, OR (ii) CYCLE-27 PRESERVE-BRANCH SHAPE (active once the oracle-agent commit on `apple-silicon-performance` lands): live buffer itself carrying reserved[0] == 0xA4000003 and reserved[1] == 2, on the cycle-26-observed reused phys (e.g. 0x03eb3000) — the agent's tightened `s_allocate_fresh` plausibility gate preserves the witness header instead of memset-wiping it. Cycle-26 outcome D (`a31e061144`) revealed that on this Xbox the kernel pool deterministically returns the same persistent phys across agent re-launches, so the live-buffer shape is the EXPECTED success surface for cycle 27 readbacks. If the cycle-26 run is repeated within a single power session without an intervening power-cycle, additional A.4-tagged buffers may accumulate; Hermes must verify the hard precondition (exactly ONE live buffer with reserved[0] == 0 BEFORE chainload) holds for every attempt. Outcome A discriminator scope: image-blit's hang is in code ABSENT from witness-only (pbkit / NV2A / xbed_init / xbed_render_loop_then_capture AND the image_blit_marker helper). Independently excluding the marker helper requires a follow-on cycle that exercises it between the two fires. Outcome B (witness mechanism real-Xbox-incompatible): Xbox hangs identically to cycle-24 image-blit (no FTP/21 / agent/9001 / ICMP ping response for 5+ minutes). Outcome C (less likely): Xbox reboots + a stamped (orphan or live) buffer with reserved[0] == 0xA4000001 (MAIN_ENTERED stamped; POST_MARKER0 hung the box and a watchdog soft-reset eventually fired).

xemu-metal/canonical/cycle-25-local-smok.notes: Cycle-25 local xemu-Metal validation (this cycle, NOT cycle-26): with XEMU_GUEST_LOG=1 the XBE emits 'witness-only: main() entered (cycle 25)' + 'xbed_a4_witness: enter stage=1' + 'witness-only: fire1 returned phys=...' + 'xbed_a4_witness: enter stage=3' + 'witness-only: fire2 returned phys=...' + 'witness-only: rebooting via HalReturnToFirmware(HalRebootRoutine)' to xemu stderr. Standalone xemu has no oracle agent running so the witness scan reports 'no XCTR buffer found' and fire1/fire2 both return phys=0x00000000 — this is EXPECTED and proves only that the witness mechanism runs to completion in emulation; it does NOT predict real-Xbox behavior (xemu's MmGetPhysicalAddress emulation cannot reproduce real-Xbox MMIO-aliasing failure modes). Cycle-25 local validation is a smoke test only; the real discriminator answer lives in cycle 26.

real-xbox/physical/cycle-30.notes: Cycle 30 (Hermes-scheduled — NOT this session): deploy the cycle-29 oracle-agent + cycle-29 witness-only XBEs on real Xbox. Canonical cycle-26-style sequence (reachability probe -> baseline witness.scan + witness.scan-self preconditions -> reboot to dashboard -> FTP-upload both XBEs -> ensure-agent -> chainload witness-only -> poll FTP/21+agent/9001+ICMP until dashboard FTP returns -> ensure-agent -> query witness.scan AND witness.scan-self). Discriminator scope (Codex round-1 high finding #2 adopted): cycle-29 readback is positioned narrowly as a (γ)-only discriminator. A witness.scan-self hit proves main() ran AND writes to a self-owned persistent page survive the chainload; it does NOT exercise the failing write into the agent's XCTR page, so cause (β) 'scan finds XCTR but write faults silently' REMAINS LIVE even on success. Breaking α-vs-β requires cycle 31+ option (b). Expected outcomes: (E1 — full success) witness.scan D-cycle-27 (`count=1 live=1 reserved0=0 reserved1=0`) AND witness.scan-self `count=1 reserved0=0xA4000003 reserved1=2` => main() ran AND BOTH self-witness fires landed AND self-allocated WTNS page is findable from non-agent process context => (γ) INVALIDATED; (α) AND (β) both REMAIN LIVE; cycle 31 promotes option (b) for α-vs-β discrimination. (E1' — partial: first self-fire only) witness.scan D-cycle-27 AND witness.scan-self `count=1 reserved0=0xA4000001 reserved1=1` => main() reached self-fire-1 but a soft watchdog reset fired between self-fire-1 and self-fire-2 OR self-fire-2's write did not propagate. (γ) INVALIDATED in the self-fire-1 sense; same α-vs-β follow-up as E1. (E1'' — allocated-but-not-stamped: very unlikely) witness.scan D-cycle-27 AND witness.scan-self `count=1 reserved0=0 reserved1=0` => page allocated + magic/version stamped but neither stage write survived; reader tolerates this shape because it matches the canonical fresh-allocation header; cycle 31 instrument the writer. (E2 — γ leading) witness.scan-self `count=0` AND witness.scan unchanged => no stamp landed anywhere => (γ) leading + cycle-22 pre-main-crash hypothesis re-strengthens; cycle 31+ promotes option (d) on-screen breadcrumb. (E3 — both mechanisms work) witness.scan A1 or A2 success shape (cycle-27 preserve-branch shape) AND witness.scan-self `count=1 reserved0=0xA4000003 reserved1=2` => cycle-26/28 readbacks must have been observation-side artifacts; full re-validation required. (E4 — hang) Xbox hangs identically to cycle 24's 928 s indefinite hang => the cycle-29 own-page allocation OR the new cycle-23-then-cycle-29-fires ordering is a new failure mode; redesign required. (E5 — accumulated orphans) witness.scan-self `count>=2` matching pattern => repeated cycle-30 attempts in same physical power session; power-cycle the Xbox between attempts. Note (Codex round-3 low finding adopted): the listed outcomes are representative, NOT exhaustive. The agent reader accepts any tagged WTNS page with reserved0's top byte == 0xA4 AND reserved1 in [1, 4096]; partial-success edge cases like `reserved0=0xA4000003 reserved1=1` (second self-fire stage byte stamped but first fire's counter increment did not propagate) are tolerated by the reader and should be interpreted as γ-invalidating with the counter + stage byte pinpointing how far main() got.

real-xbox/physical/cycle-32.notes: Cycle 32 (Hermes-scheduled — NOT THIS SESSION; cycle 31 is the implementation-only slice): deploy the cycle-31 witness-only XBE (155 648 B, +4 096 B from cycle 29; the new XVideoSetMode + framebuffer-paint code fits in one nxdk XBE page boundary) and run the cycle-30 canonical sequence with one additional procedural step: ARM the composite-capture leg (scripts/apple-silicon/composite-record.sh + MS2109 USB stick + ffmpeg AVFoundation) BEFORE issuing runxbe, and STOP capture AFTER dashboard FTP returns. Discriminator scope: cycle-31 is a (γ)-discriminator with finer granularity than cycle 29. Five 96-row horizontal stripes painted top-to-bottom on a 640x480x32 framebuffer (stripe 0 RED 0xFFFF0000 / stripe 1 ORANGE 0xFFFF7F00 / stripe 2 YELLOW 0xFFFFFF00 / stripe 3 GREEN 0xFF00FF00 / stripe 4 BLUE 0xFF0000FF) encode the deepest checkpoint reached during main(): stripe 0 = main() reached its first executable instruction (XVideoSetMode + paint of stripe 0 completed BEFORE the cycle-25 host-log + cycle-23 first fire); stripe 1 = xbed_a4_witness_fire(MAIN_ENTERED) returned; stripe 2 = xbed_a4_witness_fire(POST_MARKER0) returned; stripe 3 = xbed_self_witness_fire(MAIN_ENTERED) returned; stripe 4 = xbed_self_witness_fire(POST_MARKER0) returned. The final 2 000 ms Sleep gives the composite stream ≥60 frames of the deepest-painted state for redundant sampling. Expected outcomes (representative, NOT exhaustive — see README.md): F1 all 5 stripes + witness.scan-self `count=1 reserved0=0xA4000003 reserved1=2` + witness.scan D-cycle-27 => main() ran past every checkpoint AND the cycle-29 WTNS self-witness landed AND the cycle-23 XCTR witness did NOT land (witness.scan still D-cycle-27 means no XCTR stamp survived on the agent's persistent buffer). γ INVALIDATED; (α) OR (β) is the XCTR-side failure mode. Cycle 33 promotes option (b) for α-vs-β discrimination on the XCTR side (NOT 'both mechanisms landed' — only WTNS landed; F6 below is the only outcome that means both succeeded); F2 stripes 0..2 only + witness.scan-self count=0 + witness.scan D-cycle-27 => main() ran past cycle-23 fires but crashed before self-fire1 site (cycle 33 instruments the gap); F3 stripe 0 only + witness.scan-self count=0 + witness.scan D-cycle-27 => main() ran past first instruction but did NOT return from xbed_a4_witness_fire(MAIN_ENTERED) — strong cycle-23 mechanism failure signal on real Xbox in this minimal XBE; F4 no stripes visible + witness.scan-self count=0 + witness.scan D-cycle-27 => either (γ.0) execution never entered main() AT ALL OR (γ.1) XVideoSetMode itself faulted (main() never returned from kernel display init); the init-failed state latches in xbed_breadcrumb_init so only ONE XVideoSetMode call is at risk; cycle-22 pre-main hypothesis FULLY CORROBORATED in its strongest form; cycle 33 ships pre-main breadcrumbs. F4' no stripes visible + witness.scan-self count=1 reserved0=0xA4000003 reserved1=2 (or partial WTNS shape) + witness.scan D-cycle-27 => graceful XVideoSetMode FALSE return — main() DID execute past paint(0) (which became a no-op when the helper latched FAILED) AND went on to run the cycle-29 self-witness fires; the AV encoder rejected the requested 640×480×32 mode (exotic AV configuration); γ INVALIDATED via the WTNS path (stripe-0 absence is informative about kernel display init's behavior, NOT about main() execution); cycle 33 investigates the AV encoder rejection cause (probe XVideoListModes enumeration); F5 all 5 stripes + witness.scan-self count=0 + witness.scan D-cycle-27 => exotic; both fire pairs ran but writes never reached RAM (re-elevates option (b) for cache-attribute characterization on the agent's persistent page); F6 all 5 stripes + witness.scan-self success + witness.scan A1/A2 success shape => full success across both mechanisms AND cycles 26/28/30 must have been observation-side artifacts (cycle 33 considers declaring discriminator track CLOSED); F7 stripes painted with intermediate bands missing => paint-helper bug (should be vanishingly rare; re-run; if reproducible instrument the paint helper); F8 no composite capture available => cycle-32 procedural failure NOT a discriminator answer (re-run with capture confirmed armed). Hard preconditions in addition to cycle 30's: composite-capture leg ARMED before runxbe AND verified MS2109 USB stick recognized via tools/xemu-capture list. The cycle-31 timing may shift ~5..15 s slower than cycle 30's t+39s due to the extra XVideoSetMode kernel call + 2 000 ms settle Sleep — track separately, not load-bearing for the F1..F8 classification.
